user.title: GEN24 Energy Control – Basics
user.description: Step 1 of 3. First choose the inverter connection and the price source.

data_description.inverter_url: Base URL of the Fronius GEN24, for example http://192.168.178.135. The integration later writes to /config/timeofuse.
data_description.price_sensor: Sensor with price slots in its 'data' attribute, ideally the total-price sensor from the EPEX Spot integration.

forecast.title: GEN24 Energy Control – PV forecast
forecast.description: Step 2 of 3. Now choose the solar forecast sensors in the correct order.

data.solar_forecast_sensors: Daily forecast sensors (today → tomorrow → later days)

data_description.solar_forecast_sensors: Ordered daily list with at least 2 and at most 7 sensors. Order: today, tomorrow, day 3, day 4, day 5, day 6, day 7. Each sensor must expose the daily forecast in kWh as its state.
data_description.solar_forecast_remaining_today_sensor: Optional sensor for the forecast provider's direct remaining-today kWh estimate. This is preferred because it is more robust than forecast today minus production so far.
data_description.pv_production_today_sensor: Fallback only: actual PV production today in kWh. Used when no direct remaining-today forecast is available.

live.title: GEN24 Energy Control – Live data & write protection
live.description: Step 3 of 3. These live sensors make the policy easier to understand and more stable. Writing to the inverter stays disabled by default.

data_description.battery_soc_sensor: Current battery state of charge in percent. Without it, price- and SOC-based decisions stay in the safe fallback path.
data_description.house_load_sensor: Current house load in W. Important so expensive and cheap price windows can be evaluated correctly.
data_description.grid_export_sensor: Current export power in W. Helps the hysteresis logic so short cloud events or small fluctuations do not trigger immediate toggling.
data_description.battery_charge_power_sensor: Current battery charge power in W. Improves charge-limit planning when export curtailment or PV peaks are likely.
data_description.write_enabled: Disabled by default for safety. Enable only after the calculated sensor values and reasons look plausible in Home Assistant.

error.forecast_entities_too_few: Select at least two forecast entities: today and tomorrow.
error.forecast_entities_too_many: Select at most seven forecast entities: today through day 7.
error.invalid_inverter_url: Enter a complete http:// or https:// inverter URL.
